title: Comment "Canva" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude + Canva is a literal cheat code
description: Comment "Canva" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude + Canva is a literal cheat code. You can now create any Canva design you want directly inside Claude. Here's how to set it up in 30 seconds: 1. Go to Claude → Customize → Connectors → Browse Connectors 2. Find Canva and click Connect 3. Log into your account That's it. Canva is officially connected. Now just say "use Canva" and ask for whatever you want. Claude generates carousels, posters, banners—anything you need. Click any design and hit "open in Canva" to fully edit it directly inside Canva. Then post everything straight to your social media without ever leaving Claude. #ai #claude #canva #design #contentcreation
